subject: Língua Portuguesa
description_pt: Identificar o objeto da reclamação e/ou da solicitação e sua sustentação, explicação ou justificativa, de forma a poder analisar a pertinência da solicitação ou justificação.

components.description_pt: Identificar assunto de reclamação ou solicitação em texto lido
components.description_en: Identify the subject of a complaint or request in a read text
components.cc_component_description: Explain the author's specific question, topic, or subject being addressed in a text

components.description_pt: Identificar explicação ou justificativa sustentando reclamação ou solicitação
components.description_en: Identify the explanation or justification supporting a complaint or request
components.cc_component_description: Identify the main idea of an informational text and its relationship to supporting ideas

components.description_pt: Analisar relevância de justificativa fornecida em relação a reclamação ou solicitação feita
components.description_en: Analyze the relevance of the justification provided in relation to the complaint or request made
components.cc_component_description: Evaluate whether evidence provided in a text is relevant and sufficient to support claims

cc_matches.description: Identify the main purpose of a text, including what the author wants to answer, explain, or describe.

Multilingual learners will interpret informational texts in language arts by
* Identifying and/or summarizing main ideas __and their relationship to supporting ideas__
* Analyzing __observations and descriptions in textual evidence for key attributes, qualities, characteristics, activities, and behaviors__
* Evaluating the impact of __author’s__ key word choices __over the course of a text__

Delineate and evaluate the argument and specific claims in a text, assessing whether the reasoning is sound and the evidence is relevant and sufficient; recognize when irrelevant evidence is introduced.
